profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at govWorks, LLC.
profile.summary:
Web developer and computer programmer specialized in E-Commerce and Learning Platforms. Owns communication skills and management of small software development teams, as well as ability to learn new  knowledge and develop skills quickly. 
In the professional field has developed at teaching in the area of computer sciences as well as development of  software as a computer programmer. 
I have developed organizational skills and work strategies to work in teams and under pressure and stress.
Characterized by constant spirit of perseverance and dedication to work, considers a person who is never satisfied with the successes achieved, and constantly keeps looking for alternatives that contribute to improve results.
Among his main features are activities that commit to performance, work with professionalism and enthusiasm seeking to fulfill the objectives of the organization and achieve personal goals.
